_comment: Body app, Today tab, Template. Stephen's own daily list from his Oct 29, 2026 voice memo, in the habits schema from all-day/js/habits-core.js. Each habit has text (60 characters or fewer), frequency ('daily', 'weekdays' or 'n_per_week'), n (1 to 6, only for n_per_week, otherwise null), shared (false by default) and a category from HABIT_RULES.categories. 'why' and 'links' are extra fields for the template card; the habits tab ignores them when it copies a habit in. Anyone can copy the whole list or pick single habits and edit them.
name: Live like Stephen
blurb: The list I actually run every day. Some things are daily and some are a few times a week. Copy it, cut what doesn't fit, and make it yours.
